evidence: The track is best walked or ridden as described below, from south to north.

From the car park on Kiwi Road a well-graded track follows the eastern side of Bartletts Ridge before crossing the head of Bartletts Creek and climbing to the Foster Creek– Bartletts Creek saddle, known as Foster’s Clearing.
A bridge crosses Doom Creek before a short climb up to the benched track that leads to the road end at Butchers Flat.

ways.label: Wakamarina Track mountain bike ride from Onamalutu Reserve to Canvastown

via.name: Devil's Creek Hut
via.quote: Devils Creek Hut in the Wakamarina Valley is around halfway

evidence: Mountain bikers could complete the trip in one day, and it is best ridden from Onamalutu Reserve (Blenheim end) to Canvastown (Havelock end).
It is grade 3 (intermediate) to grade 5 (expert). 45 km, 1–2 days.

doubts: The Butchers Flat end is F2 (the only other road end, an unnamed track meeting Wakamarina Road); the text places the Butchers Flat road end at the track's end, so F2 is my best match but not certain. 'Crossing the head of Bartletts Creek' names no bridge, so it is marked ford on judgement from the wording; no ford is recorded for the unnamed creeks crossed on the Foster section, and the bridged Doom Creek is not a ford. The mountain bike ride (W2) is a separate way with its own heading and distance; its start and end are named in the text only and have no packet entries, and its via is limited to Devils Creek Hut because the text gives no other places on the bike route. Bartletts Road/Bartletts Creek Road 4WD access is not recorded as an access point because the text does not say where it joins the track. The Golden Bar Claim at Deep Creek is only the destination of the water race described on the Doom Track side trip; it is not stated to be reached on either way.
